title: Transformation of Thalassiosira pseudonana via bacterial conjugation
author: Ana Cristina Jaramillo Madrid
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7fghjjw

steps.title: Prepare Bacterial Overnight Culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate 5 mL LB medium containing gentamicin and antibiotic 2 with bacterial colonies from gentamicin + antibiotic 2 plates and grow overnight.

steps.title: Expand Bacterial Culture
steps.instruction: Start a 150 mL LB subculture using the 5 mL overnight culture, targeting a starting OD600 of 0.05 or 0.1.

substeps.instruction: Grow at 37°C until OD600 reaches 0.4 (range of 0.4 to 0.6 is acceptable).

steps.title: Harvest and Resuspend Bacteria
steps.instruction: Concentrate the bacterial cells and resuspend them in SOC medium.

steps.title: Prepare Diatom Cells
steps.instruction: Prepare a concentrated suspension of Thalassiosira pseudonana cells cultured in L1 medium.

substeps.instruction: Measure cell concentration and calculate volume needed to collect 2 x 10^8 cells.
Spin cells down (successful at ~2-4 x 10^6 cells/mL).
Decant supernatant and resuspend pellet in 1 mL L1 medium to reach a final concentration of 2 x 10^8 cells/mL.

steps.title: Perform Bacterial Conjugation
steps.instruction: Mix the bacterial and diatom cells to initiate conjugation.

substeps.instruction: Mix 200 µL diatom cells and 200 µL E. coli cells in a 1.5 mL tube.
Pipette up and down a few times.

steps.title: Initial Incubation for Conjugation
steps.instruction: Plate the mixture and incubate under specific conditions to allow conjugation.

substeps.instruction: Plate on dry 1/2xL1 1% agar plates containing 5% LB.
Incubate in the dark at 30°C for 90 minutes.

steps.title: Recovery Incubation
steps.instruction: Move plates to standard diatom growth conditions (18°C and constant light, or room temperature and constant light) and incubate for 20-24 hours.

steps.title: Recover Cells from Plates
steps.instruction: Harvest the cells from the agar plates.

substeps.instruction: Spin down at 4000 g, 10°C, for 10 min.
Add 1 mL L1 medium and scrape.

steps.title: Selection and Growth
steps.instruction: Plate the recovered cells on selective media and grow until colonies appear.

substeps.instruction: Plate 200 µL of the resulting suspension on pre-dried 1/2xL1 1% agar plates containing 50 ug/ml nourseothricin.
Incubate at 18°C and constant light for approximately 10-12 days until colonies appear.
